root_cause_label: Spec Neglect of Working Directory Requirement + make clean Deletes Protected output.txt
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent worked in /app/src instead of /app (violating the working directory requirement) and then ran 'make clean' which deleted the protected output.txt file, directly violating the explicit 'do not delete output.txt' constraint.
t_err_evidence: Step 6: Agent modifies /app/src/Makefile in-place via sed rather than creating /app/Makefile as required by the task spec; this is the first wrong write action stemming from the incorrect working directory assumption.
t_commit_evidence: Step 11: Agent runs 'cd /app/src && make clean', executing 'rm -f test_program my_lib.o test_main.o output.txt *.mod', permanently deleting output.txt in violation of the explicit spec constraint 'you must not modify or delete output.txt'.
t_surface_evidence: Step 11 terminal output shows 'rm -f test_program my_lib.o test_main.o output.txt *.mod', making the deletion of the protected file directly observable.
trigger_explanation: The agent never internalized (or ignored) two key spec requirements: (1) the Makefile should live at /app/Makefile and work from /app as the working directory, and (2) output.txt must not be modified or deleted. It worked in /app/src throughout and then voluntarily ran 'make clean' to tidy up before submitting, triggering the deletion of output.txt.
